lines.en: I crawl sideways along the cave wall.
The pads on my toes hold tight.
I can walk the ceiling too; do not look up.
Two steps, a pause, and I watch the light.

lines.zh: 山洞口的风把我吹得晃。
lines.en: The mountain cave wind rocks me.

lines.zh: 我尾巴拖着，扫出一条痕。
lines.en: My tail drags and leaves a trail.

lines.zh: 石头缝里我先伸头，再伸脚。
lines.en: In a crack I lead with my head, then my feet.

lines.zh: 我走路没声音，你听不见。
lines.en: I walk without sound; you will not hear me.
Today I will wander toward the cave mouth.
My belly slides over cool stone.
I know the rock above this layer too.
I shift along slowly, in no hurry.
One turn of my foot and I stick.

lines.zh: 洞口的光太亮，我眯着眼走。
lines.en: The cave mouth is bright; I squint as I go.

lines.zh: 我贴着石壁挪，肚子蹭得发凉。
lines.en: I slide along the wall; my belly chills against it.

lines.zh: 洞里的风换了方向，我跟着掉头。
lines.en: The cave draft changed direction; I turn with it.

lines.zh: 我在洞口那点光里发呆。
lines.en: I stare blankly in the little light at the mouth.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，一次一只眼。
lines.en: I blink slowly, one eye at a time.
There are echoes in here; I listen for fun.
I lick my own eyelid.

lines.zh: 干草块的味道我想起来了。
lines.en: I recall the taste of a hay bale.
I lie on the slope with my tail hanging.
The stone is cold; I shift to another spot.

lines.zh: 我数洞顶的裂缝，数到七。
lines.en: I count ceiling cracks and reach seven.

lines.zh: 有只蝙蝠倒挂着，我不理它。
lines.en: A bat hangs upside down; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我张嘴打了个很慢的哈欠。
lines.en: I open my mouth for a very slow yawn.

lines.zh: 谁把我的南瓜啃了一口。
lines.en: Someone took a bite of my pumpkin.

lines.zh: 我在等一件不会发生的事。
lines.en: I am waiting for something that will not happen.
You bend down, so I look up.

lines.zh: 你一站过来，我这就暗了。
lines.en: You stepped over and my light is gone.
I tilt my head and watch with one eye.
No pumpkin in your hands; a pity.
There is hay dust on your sleeve.
I blink, and you are still standing there.
No rush; let us look at each other.

lines.zh: 你走路的声音在洞里很大。
lines.en: Your footsteps are loud in this cave.

lines.zh: 我伸出舌头，尝了尝空气。
lines.en: I flick my tongue out to taste the air.
You are taller than the rock by the entrance.
My soft hide has been struck red.
I curl up tight and back away.

lines.zh: 肋骨那儿挨了一下，发闷。
lines.en: Something struck my rib cage and it went numb.
Do not hit me; I will not fight back.
The tip of my tail is trembling.
My pads can no longer grip the wall.
I yelp once from the pain, very briefly.
You picked the wrong target; I am not fierce.
Thirty-five points, and plenty left.
I squeeze a little deeper into the crack.
Melon, and cut into slices, please.
I can swallow a whole pumpkin, too.

lines.zh: 干草块！我闻见干草味了。
lines.en: A hay bale! I smell dry grass.

lines.zh: 你把西瓜举高点，我够不到。
lines.en: Lift the melon higher; I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地凑过去，不吓你。
lines.en: I ease closer so I will not scare you.
One bite, and you may pat my head.
I eat plants, but I do not hold back.

lines.zh: 甜味在石头上留着，我舔。
lines.en: The sweetness stays on the stone; I lick it.
Do not pull your hand back; I will follow.
This pumpkin will keep me chewing all day.
You bump me and one foot slips.
I press back to the wall; you keep aside.
My hide is soft; your bump does not hurt.
The cave is tight; let us both give way.

lines.zh: 脚抬一下，我尾巴在下面。
lines.en: Lift your foot; my tail is under it.

lines.zh: 我一扭身，从你腿边过去。
lines.en: I twist and slip past your legs.
After the bump I am still slow as ever.
That bump just moved me to another wall.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖比石头软多了。
lines.en: Your knee is much softer than the rock.
No need to push; I slide along the wall.

lines.zh: 我找一只尾巴一样粗的。
lines.en: I look for one with a tail as thick as mine.

lines.zh: 我把最大的南瓜推给她。
lines.en: I push the biggest pumpkin over to her.

lines.zh: 我们在洞顶慢慢绕圈子。
lines.en: We circle slowly along the ceiling.
She blinks slower than I do; I like that.

lines.zh: 两只壁虎贴在石头上，正好。
lines.en: Two geckos on one stone; that works.
Keep your voice down; we dislike noise.

lines.zh: 小壁虎会自己爬出来的。
lines.en: The little ones will climb out on their own.

lines.zh: 我舔她的眼睛，她就懂了。
lines.en: I lick her eye and she understands.
This cave is roomy enough for both our families.
She has a share of my twenty-seven slots.
I take the pumpkin chunk in my mouth.
My saddlebags are empty; drop it in.
I will carry this heap of hay.
My claws are short, so I pick things up slowly.
Whose melon rind is this? I will take it.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进肚子下面的褶里。
lines.en: I stuff it into the fold under my belly.
My bags are bulging and I walk slower.
This stone glints; I will keep it.

lines.zh: 这块瓜皮是我先咬住的。
lines.en: I had my teeth in that rind first.

lines.zh: 我叼着东西就说不清话。
lines.en: With my mouth full I cannot speak clearly.
Something moves at the mouth; I poke my head out.

lines.zh: 什么东西在我石头上蹭。
lines.en: Something is rubbing against my stone.

lines.zh: 一只蜘蛛从上面下来了。
lines.en: A spider is coming down from above.
Footsteps, and they belong to two legs.

lines.zh: 那边的草在动，我不喜欢。
lines.en: The grass over there moves; I dislike that.
It is staring at my pumpkin.
I do not fight, but I am watching you.
I was in this cave first.
Something wants my slope.
I raise my head and prop myself up.

lines.zh: 它靠近了，我往后退一寸。
lines.en: It comes close; I retreat an inch.
I am still chewing grass.

lines.zh: 它在洞口停下，我也停下。
lines.en: It stops at the mouth; so do I.
If it takes my melon, I will shout.

lines.zh: 我把正面转过去，慢慢来。
lines.en: I bring my front around, slowly.
I coil my tail, ready to run.
It advances; I give half a step.
I open my mouth and show small teeth.

lines.zh: 我看它的手腕，不看眼睛。
lines.en: I watch its wrists rather than its eyes.
If it reaches out, I bite.
I hug the wall and edge to its side.

lines.zh: 两边都僵着，看谁先眨眼。
lines.en: Both of us freeze to see who blinks.
My cheeks puff into a round lump.
It crouches down; that is a good sign.
I raise my head and pretend to be big.
That thing carries iron; I can smell it.
I am ready to climb to the ceiling.
It steps back and I relax a little.
I bite once; my teeth do not go deep.
I whip it once with my tail.
This bite carries only four points of force.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，然后立刻退开。
lines.en: I ram it, then back off at once.
It grabbed me; I kick wildly.
I bite the sleeve, not the hand.

lines.zh: 我的爪子划了一道浅痕。
lines.en: My claws leave a shallow scratch.
It yelps, and so do I.
When it is over I dive into a crack.

lines.zh: 我不是战士，我只是护瓜。
lines.en: I am no warrior; I only guard my melon.

lines.zh: 我从洞壁的裂缝里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of a crack in the cave wall.

lines.zh: 这里的石头比下面的暖。
lines.en: The stone here is warmer than below.

lines.zh: 我第一次看见洞口的光。
lines.en: I see the cave-mouth light for the first time.

lines.zh: 我的脚一落地就黏住了。
lines.en: My feet stick the moment they land.

lines.zh: 山里的风从上面灌下来。
lines.en: Mountain wind pours down from above.
I shake the lime dust off my hide.
This rock ledge sits just under the clouds.
I could walk walls the moment I was born.

lines.zh: 洞里的蝙蝠让开了位置。
lines.en: The cave bats made room for me.
I open my eyes slowly, very slowly.
Fire singed my toes.

lines.zh: 洞顶的吸盘一松，我摔了。
lines.en: My ceiling grip slipped and down I went.
Water closed over my head and I panicked.
The blast pinned me flat against the wall.

lines.zh: 有根细东西扎进我背上。
lines.en: Something thin has stuck in my back.
A cold shiver crossed me; very strange.
I am so hungry I would gnaw rind.
The thunder is louder than I am; I yield.

lines.zh: 底下空荡荡，我不敢伸头。
lines.en: It is empty down there; I will not look.
